title: A swallowed suggestion failure is only returned in the result; nothing logs it and no caller reads result.speakerSuggestions
evidence: 2d036804: suggestSpeakersForSession catches every error and returns {error}; indexSession returns it as result.speakerSuggestions, but grep finds no consumer outside types/session/production, and the hook has no console.warn (every other degraded path in session.ts logs with console.warn). With KB_SPEAKER_SUGGEST=1 a DB or model failure leaves no trace. Mutation 'rethrow instead of return' survives speaker-suggest.test.ts: the existing 'model that throws' test never reaches the catch because extractSpeakersGrounded degrades instead of throwing.
fix_direction: console.warn(`indexSession(${tenantId}/${sessionId}): speaker suggestions failed: ${error}`) in the catch (and on degraded), and add a test with a Db whose find() throws.
verification_note: Verified by checker verdict aeb2495e (lane/w17-wu24, candidate 000cbd5c).

title: Production default of the flag is untested, and the awaited suggestion call is unbounded in time
evidence: Mutation production.ts 'options.suggestSpeakers ?? true' survives all tests (production.ts is never imported by tests); only speakerSuggestEnabled() itself is tested. The hook is awaited at the end of indexSession with up to 3 proposer plus verifier model calls and no timeout, so a slow or hung ollama delays the indexing job's return (the session is already marked index=done). Also one of two full apps/api runs showed 2 transient failures (811/813), the rerun was 813/813.
fix_direction: Test buildIndexer's default with the env unset/set; wrap the hook in a timeout (or run it detached) before enabling the flag in production.
verification_note: Verified by checker verdict aeb2495e (lane/w17-wu24, candidate 000cbd5c).

title: Default 300 s timeout value untested; timed-out run() is not cancelled
evidence: Mutation SPEAKER_SUGGEST_TIMEOUT_MS 300_000 -> 3_000_000 SURVIVES (tests inject timeoutMs). Also Promise.race does not abort run(): after a timeout the grounder/insert keeps running in the background and may still insert suggested-only rows (no final write, no unhandled rejection).
fix_direction: Assert the exported constant equals 300000; optionally pass an AbortSignal. File-dont-fix per cycle cap.
verification_note: Verified by checker verdict aeb2495e (lane/w17-wu24, candidate 000cbd5c).
